data_objects.name: baseball_player_records
data_objects.meaning: Baseball player records containing salary, batting and fielding statistics, and free-agency or arbitration eligibility indicators.
data_objects.notes: Player identifiers and the reporting period for the statistics are not included.

variables.name: salary_in_thousands_of_dollars
variables.meaning: Player salary expressed in thousands of dollars.

variables.name: on_base_percentage
variables.meaning: Player on-base percentage represented as a proportion.

variables.name: number_of_runs
variables.meaning: Number of runs recorded for the player.

variables.name: number_of_hits
variables.meaning: Number of hits recorded for the player.

variables.name: number_of_doubles
variables.meaning: Number of doubles recorded for the player.

variables.name: number_of_triples
variables.meaning: Number of triples recorded for the player.

variables.name: number_of_home_runs
variables.meaning: Number of home runs recorded for the player.

variables.name: number_of_runs_batted_in
variables.meaning: Number of runs batted in recorded for the player.

variables.name: number_of_walks
variables.meaning: Number of walks recorded for the player.

variables.name: number_of_strike_outs
variables.meaning: Number of strikeouts recorded for the player.

variables.name: number_of_stolen_bases
variables.meaning: Number of stolen bases recorded for the player.

variables.name: number_of_errors
variables.meaning: Number of fielding errors recorded for the player.

variables.name: indicator_of_free_agent_in_1991_1992
variables.meaning: Binary indicator that the player was a free agent in 1991-1992.

variables.name: indicator_of_arbitration_in_1991_1992
variables.meaning: Binary indicator that the player was in arbitration in 1991-1992.

structure.description: Each row represents one player record combining salary, performance statistics, and contract-status indicators; no explicit player key is present.
Eligibility and 1991-1992 status fields are encoded as binary numeric indicators, with blank cells representing an undocumented missing state where present.

uncertainties: The league, season or career window, salary period, and player identities are not supplied.
The missing-value convention for indicator and count fields is not documented.
annotation_notes: Statistics and contract-status meanings follow the explicit source column names without assigning an unstated season context.
